verified_key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue increased by 11% to EUR 338.3 million in 2024, driven by net interest income growth of 8% to EUR 273.3 million and net fee and commission income growth of 24% to EUR 60.3 million; net profit rose 7% to EUR 150.3 million, resulting in a cost-to-income ratio of 43.4% and return on equity of 24.5%.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (pages 10-11); Consolidated statement of profit or loss (page 189)

candidate_sentences.text: Profit before tax rose to EUR 175.1 million from EUR 164.6 million, while net income increased 11% to EUR 338.3 million.
Net interest income grew 8% to EUR 273.3 million and net fee and commission income rose 24% to EUR 60.3 million, supported by asset growth and higher customer activity.
LHV Group reported a record 2024, with consolidated net profit increasing 7% year on year to EUR 150.3 million, including EUR 149.0 million attributable to the owners of the parent.
Return on equity remained high at 24.5%, although it declined from 29.0% in 2023, and return on assets fell to 1.9% from 2.1%.

verified_key_information_units.information: The loan portfolio expanded by EUR 990 million (28% YoY) to EUR 4.6 billion, comprising Estonian corporate loans up 21% to EUR 2.3 billion, Estonian retail loans up 21% to EUR 1.9 billion, and UK SME loans up 338% to EUR 0.3 billion.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Note 12, Loans and advances to customers (page 223)

candidate_sentences.text: Net loans increased by EUR 990 million, or 28%, to EUR 4.6 billion.
Estonian corporate and retail loan portfolios each grew by 21%, while UK SME lending increased 338% to EUR 348 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Deposits grew by EUR 1,179 million (21% YoY) to EUR 6.9 billion, with regular customer deposits in LHV Pank rising EUR 554 million (14% YoY to EUR 4.6 billion) and deposits from financial intermediaries increasing significantly (LHV Bank collections up EUR 416 million, +388% YoY), partly offset by LHV Pank reducing platform deposits by one-third.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report, Summary of the year 2024 (page 10); Note 17, Deposits from customers (page 226)

candidate_sentences.text: Customer deposits rose 21% to EUR 6.9 billion, including a 14% increase in regular LHV Pank deposits.

verified_key_information_units.information: Assets under management increased to EUR 1.56 billion (3% YoY), primarily due to positive market returns, with LHV Varahaldus maintaining a ~25% market share in Estonia's II pillar pension system managing savings for 22.3% of participants.

candidate_sentences.text: LHV Paytech’s profit rose 40% to EUR 0.7 million, while LHV Varahaldus’ profit declined slightly to EUR 1.6 million; assets under management increased 3% to EUR 1.56 billion.

verified_key_information_units.information: Customer base grew with LHV Pank reaching 456,000 clients (+9% YoY, including 38,000 new customers), and LHV Kindlustus insuring 170,000 customers (+6% YoY).

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic initiatives included launching retail banking operations in the UK, introducing a mobile banking app, and implementing cost-control measures involving redundancies and departmental restructuring to enhance operational efficiency.

candidate_sentences.text: LHV Bank’s profit rose to EUR 5.8 million from EUR 5.3 million as it expanded UK lending and deposits and launched retail banking.
The Group strengthened its UK platform, issued EUR 300 million of MREL bonds and EUR 20 million of Tier 2 bonds, and implemented cost-control measures.
